newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ebara Corp wins 11 bln yen Taiwan plant orders.
newsitem.headline: Ebara Corp wins 11 bln yen Taiwan plant orders.

text.p: Ebara Corp said on Monday it had won about 11 billion yen worth of orders for compressors and turbines to be used at a new oil and petrochemical complex on the west coast of Taiwan.

The Japanese engineering firm received the orders from Formosa Petrochemical Corp, which was set up jointly by three petrochemical firms: Formosa Plastics Corp, Formosa Chemical & Fibre Corp and Nan Ya Plastics Corp, an Ebara spokesman said.
Ebara will supply some 40 large compressors and turbines, to be used at production facilities including residue fluid catalytic crackers and naphtha crackers, by February 1999, he said.

The new complex, whose production units will include three 150,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation units and an ethylene plant with annual capacity of about one million tonnes, is expected to be operational by the spring of 1999, the spokesman said.
